tools.name: learnworlds_list_courses
tools.description: List the school's courses, newest first, 50 per page — title, price fields, access (paid/free/draft...), categories and author. A cheap way to confirm the credentials work. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/courses.

tools.name: learnworlds_get_course
tools.description: Fetch one course by id (its slug). LearnWorlds: GET /v2/courses/{id}.

tools.name: learnworlds_get_course_contents
tools.description: The course outline: its sections (with drip-feed settings) and the learning activities (videos, PDFs, SCORM, assessments, certificates...) in each, with their ids. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/courses/{id}/contents.

tools.name: learnworlds_get_course_analytics
tools.description: Course-level analytics: students, learning units, average score and success rate, total study time, average time to finish, social interactions and certificates issued. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/courses/{id}/analytics.

tools.name: learnworlds_list_course_users
tools.description: The users enrolled in one course, newest first (20 per page by default). LearnWorlds: GET /v2/courses/{id}/users.

tools.name: learnworlds_get_course_grades
tools.description: Assessment grades of the users enrolled in a course — per user and learning unit, with submission time. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/courses/{id}/grades.

tools.name: learnworlds_list_users
tools.description: List the school's users, newest first (20 per page by default), filterable by status, role, tags, registration date and custom fields. All filters are ANDed. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/users.

tools.name: learnworlds_get_user
tools.description: Fetch one user by id or email — profile, role, tags, sign-up fields, UTMs and last login. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/users/{id}.

tools.name: learnworlds_list_user_courses
tools.description: The courses a user is enrolled in, with enrollment and expiry dates (50 per page). LearnWorlds: GET /v2/users/{id}/courses.

tools.name: learnworlds_get_user_course_progress
tools.description: A user's progress in one course — status, progress rate, average score, time on course, completed units, and a per-section / per-activity breakdown. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/users/{id}/courses/{cid}/progress.

tools.name: learnworlds_list_payments
tools.description: List payments, newest first (50 per page by default) — product, price, discount, tax, coupon, affiliate, gateway and billing info. All filters are ANDed. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/payments.

tools.name: learnworlds_get_payment
tools.description: Fetch one payment by payment id or transaction id. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/payments/{id}.

tools.name: learnworlds_list_certificates
tools.description: Certificates awarded, newest first (20 per page), for a course and/or a user — at least one of course_id or user_id is required. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/certificates.

tools.name: learnworlds_list_user_groups
tools.description: List the school's user groups (cohorts / B2B seats), newest first — title, products, group managers, capacity and tags. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/user_groups.

tools.name: learnworlds_list_event_logs
tools.description: The school's activity log (50 per page) — registrations, logins, purchases, enrollments, course completions, certificates, subscription changes and more, filterable by user, activity and time. LearnWorlds: GET /v2/event-logs.

tools.name: learnworlds_create_user
tools.description: WRITE: create a learner account. Deliberately no password or admin flag — set send_registration_email so the learner sets their own password. LearnWorlds: POST /v2/users.

tools.name: learnworlds_update_user
tools.description: WRITE: update a user's email, username, marketing consent, sign-up fields or tags. Only the fields you pass are sent. Passing `tags` REPLACES the tag list — use learnworlds_update_user_tags to add/remove individual tags. LearnWorlds: PUT /v2/users/{id}.

tools.name: learnworlds_update_user_tags
tools.description: WRITE: add (attach) or remove (detach) tags on a user, leaving their other tags untouched. Reversible with the opposite action. LearnWorlds: PUT /v2/users/{id}/tags.

tools.name: learnworlds_enroll_user
tools.description: WRITE: manually enroll a user in a course, bundle or subscription. This grants access and records a manual enrollment at the given price (use 0 for a free grant) — it does not charge the learner's card. Optionally emails the learner. LearnWorlds: POST /v2/users/{id}/enrollment.

tools.name: learnworlds_add_user_to_group
tools.description: WRITE: add an existing user to a user group (which may enroll them in the group's products). LearnWorlds: POST /v2/user_groups/{id}/users/{uid}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: learnworlds_get_course_contents, learnworlds_get_user, learnworlds_update_user · Private data: learnworlds_list_courses, learnworlds_create_user, learnworlds_enroll_user · Public sink: learnworlds_get_user, learnworlds_create_user, learnworlds_update_user, learnworlds_enroll_user, learnworlds_add_user_to_group · Destructive: learnworlds_update_user, learnworlds_update_user_tags.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: learnworlds_get_course_contents, learnworlds_get_user, learnworlds_update_user · Private data: learnworlds_list_courses, learnworlds_create_user, learnworlds_enroll_user · Public sink: learnworlds_get_user, learnworlds_create_user, learnworlds_update_user, learnworlds_enroll_user, learnworlds_add_user_to_group · Destructive: learnworlds_update_user, learnworlds_update_user_tags

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
